name: Yoga Warrior II (Side View)
description: A side-profile view of the Warrior II pose, emphasizing the flat back and strong leg alignment.
tips: Keep the spine perpendicular to the floor.
Ensure the front knee is stacked directly over the ankle.
Stretch arms parallel to the floor, reaching actively in both directions.
Gaze forward over the front fingertips.
camera_cues: Capture from a strictly lateral angle to emphasize the geometry of the pose.
Keep the camera at waist height to maintain the perspective of the horizons.
